ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations are present along the entire continuous trailing edge, with individual peak-to-valley variations ranging from 5 to 22 pixels in amplitude.
